items.name: Olympic Barbell
items.description: 20kg bar with quality knurling for cleans, snatches, and deadlifts. Look for 28–28.5mm grip diameter for WODs.

items.name: Women's 15kg Barbell
items.description: Shorter, lighter bar with a 25mm shaft — the right choice for snatches and cleans for most female athletes.

items.name: Bumper Plates
items.description: Rubber-coated plates built to be dropped safely. Essential for Olympic lifting and barbell WODs at home.

items.name: Iron Plates
items.description: Cast iron plates for strength work — deadlifts, squats, and pressing movements. More affordable than bumpers.

items.name: Dumbbells
items.description: Adjustable sets save space. Used in DB snatches, thrusters, lunges, and dozens of WOD variations.

items.name: Kettlebell
items.description: Swings, Turkish get-ups, goblet squats. One of the best single-item investments for home training.

items.name: Squat Rack
items.description: Back squats, front squats, overhead press, bench press. A power rack anchors every serious home gym.

items.name: Weight Bench
items.description: An adjustable bench opens up pressing movements and step-up alternatives for home WODs.

items.name: Barbell Collars
items.description: Essential for every barbell setup — keeps plates locked during cleans, snatches, and drops. Spring collars are fine; locking collars are better for heavy lifting.

items.name: Trap Bar / Hex Bar
items.description: More forgiving on the lower back than a straight bar deadlift. Popular in home gyms for heavy pulls, farmer carries, and loaded jumps.

items.name: Pull-up Bar
items.description: Non-negotiable for home gyms. Door-mounted or rig-mounted — needed for pull-ups, toes-to-bar, and hanging work.

items.name: Gymnastics Rings
items.description: Ring dips, muscle-ups, rows. Rings are portable, versatile, and brutally effective for upper body development.

items.name: Parallettes
items.description: Handstand push-up practice, L-sits, and dips. Low parallettes work on any floor surface.

items.name: Climbing Rope
items.description: Builds grip and pulling strength nothing else replicates. Needs ceiling height and a quality anchor point.

items.name: Freestanding Rig
items.description: Wall-less pull-up station for garages without mounting options. Supports pull-ups, rings, and muscle-up practice.

items.name: Gymnastics Grips
items.description: Protect your hands during high-rep pull-ups, toes-to-bar, and muscle-ups. Carbon fiber and leather grips are both popular — a non-negotiable once you're stringing reps together.

items.name: Chalk & Liquid Chalk
items.description: Essential for barbells, kettlebells, and gymnastics work. Liquid chalk is mess-free and allowed in most gyms that ban block chalk.

items.name: Rowing Machine
items.description: The king of home gym cardio — full-body, low-impact, and perfect for WOD intervals. Concept2 is the gold standard.

items.name: Echo / Assault Bike
items.description: Air resistance means infinite intensity. The assault bike is brutally effective for short, high-output intervals.

items.name: SkiErg
items.description: Upper body pulling and core endurance. Wall-mounted to save floor space — great for Open WOD prep.

items.name: Speed Jump Rope
items.description: Double-unders demand a quality speed rope. Look for a lightweight cable and adjustable length for your height.

items.name: Battle Ropes
items.description: High-intensity conditioning for arms, core, and lungs. Anchor to a wall or rig and go.

items.name: Weight Sled
items.description: Sled pushes and drags are low-skill, high-output conditioning. Best on turf or smooth concrete.

items.name: Treadmill
items.description: Running WODs don't stop for weather. A solid folding treadmill lets you hit run-heavy workouts year-round.

items.name: Plyo Box
items.description: Box jumps, step-ups, depth drops. A 20/24/30-inch wooden or foam box is a staple for every home gym.

items.name: Medicine Ball
items.description: Wall balls, slams, rotational throws. A 14 or 20 lb med ball shows up constantly in benchmark WODs.

items.name: Slam Ball
items.description: Built to absorb impact without bouncing back. Ball slams are a brutal full-body conditioning movement.

items.name: Sandbag
items.description: An unstable, awkward implement that builds real-world functional strength. Great for carries and cleans.

items.name: D-Ball / Heavy Ball
items.description: The squat-clean-to-shoulder ball. Weighted carries and cleans with a 100+ lb D-ball are a serious conditioning test.

items.name: Weight Vest
items.description: Murph, strict pull-ups, and running WODs get a whole new dimension with a 20 lb vest. A classic progression tool.

items.name: Resistance Bands
items.description: Banded pull-up assistance, mobility work, and accessory training. A full set covers light to heavy resistance.

items.name: GHD Machine
items.description: Glute-ham developer for GHD sit-ups and hamstring curls. Shows up in Open WODs and competitive programming.

items.name: Steel Mace
items.description: Offset loading builds rotational strength, shoulder stability, and grip endurance. A serious tool for serious athletes.

items.name: Steel Clubs
items.description: Shoulder rehab and rotational power training. Paired clubs open up a completely different movement vocabulary.

items.name: Ab Mat
items.description: Full range sit-ups and GHD-free core work. The Ab Mat supports the lumbar curve so you get the full contraction.

items.name: Wrist Wraps
items.description: Wrist stability for heavy front squats, cleans, jerks, and pressing. A small investment that protects high-volume joints over years of training.

items.name: Lifting Straps
items.description: Take grip out of the equation on heavy deadlifts, RDLs, and pulls. Simple cotton or nylon straps are all you need.

items.name: Dip Belt
items.description: Add load to pull-ups, dips, and ring work. A chain-style dip belt is the most reliable option for heavier plates.

items.name: Whey Protein
items.description: Post-WOD recovery starts with protein. Look for 20–25g per serving with minimal additives and a third-party tested label.

items.name: Creatine Monohydrate
items.description: The most studied performance supplement available. 3–5g daily supports power output on max-effort movements and AMRAP finishes.

items.name: Alpha Brain
items.description: Clinically studied nootropic for focus and mental clarity. Popular among competitive athletes for sharpening cognitive performance during training.

items.name: Shroom Tech Sport
items.description: Adaptogen-based performance formula with Cordyceps mushroom. No stimulant crash — just cleaner, more sustained output.

items.name: Pre-Workout
items.description: A quality pre-workout for early morning WODs or high-volume training days. Look for caffeine + beta-alanine + citrulline.

items.name: BCAAs
items.description: Branch-chain amino acids for intra-workout hydration and muscle preservation during fasted training or long sessions.

items.name: Electrolytes
items.description: LMNT, Liquid IV, and similar products are essential for athletes sweating through daily WODs. Proper sodium and potassium balance prevents cramping and keeps performance up.

items.name: Collagen & Joint Support
items.description: High-rep Olympic lifting and gymnastics put serious wear on tendons and joints. Collagen peptides with vitamin C support connective tissue — especially important for athletes over 30.

items.name: Fish Oil / Omega-3
items.description: Anti-inflammatory support for joints, heart health, and recovery. One of the most universally recommended supplements for high-volume athletes.

items.name: Vitamin D3 + K2
items.description: Essential for athletes who train indoors or in garages year-round. D3 supports bone density, immune function, and mood — K2 ensures calcium goes where it belongs.

items.name: Greens Powder
items.description: AG1 and similar daily greens blends cover micronutrient gaps when diet isn't perfect. One of the fastest-growing supplement categories with a high repeat purchase rate.

items.name: Ashwagandha
items.description: Adaptogen for cortisol management, stress reduction, and recovery quality. Popular with athletes who train hard and live busy lives — trending strongly across fitness communities.

items.name: Turmeric / Curcumin
items.description: Natural anti-inflammatory for post-WOD soreness and joint comfort. Look for formulas with black pepper (piperine) for better absorption.

items.name: Protein Bars
items.description: Convenient post-WOD nutrition when a shaker isn't an option. Quest, RxBar, and Built bars are popular choices — high repeat purchase and easy impulse buy.

items.name: Protein Shakes (RTD)
items.description: Ready-to-drink single-serving shakes for post-WOD recovery without the mess. Fairlife, Muscle Milk, and Core Power are top sellers — grab-and-go convenience drives consistent repurchase.

items.name: Casein Protein
items.description: Slow-digesting overnight protein that keeps your muscles fed while you sleep. Pairs naturally with whey — whey post-WOD, casein before bed.

items.name: Lion's Mane
items.description: Cognitive and neurological support from functional mushrooms. Trending alongside nootropics like Alpha Brain for athletes who prioritize mental clarity as much as physical output.

items.name: Tart Cherry Extract
items.description: Research-backed for reducing DOMS and improving sleep quality. Especially popular with athletes doing back-to-back training days who need to feel fresher faster.

items.name: Melatonin
items.description: Sleep onset support for athletes with irregular schedules or early morning WOD alarms. Pairs with magnesium glycinate for a solid sleep stack.

items.name: Nike Metcon
items.description: The definitive training shoe — stable heel, grippy rope-climb rubber wrap, and enough flexibility for running intervals.

items.name: Reebok Nano
items.description: The original functional fitness shoe. Wide toe box, flexible forefoot, and a flat heel — built for exactly this kind of training.

items.name: Training Shorts
items.description: Sweat-wicking, 4-way stretch shorts designed for high-output movement. The right fit won't limit squat depth or rope climbs.

items.name: Training Leggings
items.description: High-waisted, squat-proof leggings for barbell work, box jumps, and everything in between. Compression fit for all-day wear.

items.name: Lifting Belt
items.description: Core support for heavy barbell work — deadlifts, back squats, cleans. 4-inch belts are the functional fitness standard.

items.name: Knee Sleeves
items.description: Warmth and compression for squat-heavy WODs. 7mm neoprene sleeves are the most popular option for functional fitness.

items.name: Weightlifting Shoes
items.description: Elevated heel and rigid sole improve squat depth and bar path on cleans, snatches, and front squats. Romaleos, Adipower, and Leistung are the go-to options.

items.name: Kane Recovery Shoes
items.description: Purpose-built post-workout footwear with a curved sole and cushioned base for active recovery. Popular among serious athletes for the hour after training when your feet need a break.

items.name: Short Sleeve Workout Shirt
items.description: Moisture-wicking, 4-way stretch tees for high-output training. The right fabric keeps you dry through AMRAPs, metcons, and everything in between.

items.name: Long Sleeve Training Shirt
items.description: For cooler garage sessions and outdoor WODs. Lightweight compression or relaxed fit — both work. A staple for year-round training without overheating.

items.name: Tank Top
items.description: Maximum airflow for hot garage sessions and high-rep conditioning work. Racerback and standard cut options — lighter is better when you're sweating through round five.

items.name: Compression Shorts
items.description: Muscle support and reduced chafing during heavy squats, runs, and rope climbs. Wear alone or under training shorts — a daily staple for most serious athletes.

items.name: Sweatpants
items.description: Warm-up, cool-down, and recovery day staple. Tapered athletic sweats that work in the gym and outside it — not just loungewear.

items.name: Athletic Hoodie
items.description: Pre-WOD warmup layer and post-WOD cool-down essential. A quality pullover or zip hoodie gets worn more than almost any other piece of gym apparel.

items.name: Workout Socks
items.description: Cushioned, moisture-wicking socks built for high-rep movement. The right socks prevent blisters on long runs and rope climbs — easy add-on purchase with any footwear.

items.name: Headbands
items.description: Keep sweat and hair out of your face during handstand work and metcons. Non-slip athletic headbands are a small buy with a high repeat rate.

items.name: Women's Workout Sets
items.description: Matching two-piece sets — sports bra and leggings or shorts — designed for functional fitness. High-waisted, squat-proof, and built to move. One of the highest-converting women's fitness categories on Amazon.

items.name: Chirp Wheel
items.description: Spine decompression and thoracic mobility in one tool. The groove down the center takes pressure off the vertebrae while you roll — noticeably better than a flat foam roller for back tightness.

items.name: Pso-Rite
items.description: Targeted psoas and hip flexor release — the muscles that get wrecked by heavy squatting and sitting between WODs. The same company makes the Hip Hook and Pso-Mini for different areas.

items.name: TENS / EMS Stim Unit
items.description: Electrical muscle stimulation for active recovery and pain relief. Chirp Stim, PowerDot, and Compex are popular options — helps flush soreness between hard training days.

items.name: Elastic Resistance Bands
items.description: Multi-color loop bands for hip activation, banded mobility drills, and warm-up work. A set gives you light through heavy resistance for glutes, shoulders, and hip openers.

items.name: Massage Gun
items.description: Percussive therapy for deep tissue relief. Faster and more targeted than rolling for specific muscle soreness — quads, calves, and lats after high-rep WODs.

items.name: Magnesium Glycinate
items.description: Quality sleep is the most underrated recovery tool available. Magnesium supports deeper sleep and reduced muscle cramps after high-volume training weeks.

items.name: Cold Plunge Tub
items.description: Cold water immersion for reducing inflammation and accelerating recovery after hard training. Inflatable and portable tubs make it accessible for home gyms without a permanent setup.

items.name: Infrared Sauna
items.description: Heat therapy for muscle relaxation, circulation, and recovery. Infrared sauna blankets are a popular home option — effective and far more affordable than a full cabin unit.

items.name: Inversion Table
items.description: Spinal decompression for back pain and tightness from heavy lifting. A few minutes inverted can relieve compression that builds up over weeks of squats and deadlifts.

items.name: Foam Roller
items.description: Still the go-to for full-body SMR — quads, IT band, lats, thoracic spine. Most athletes own more than one. Great entry point and a consistent Amazon seller.

items.name: Lacrosse Ball
items.description: Targeted trigger point release for shoulders, pecs, glutes, and foot fascia. Pairs well with the Pso-Rite for deep hip work. One of the cheapest and most effective tools you can recommend.
